structured_output.summary: Request is concrete and detailed; implement upstream-style apply_conditions/apply_range, deprecate old APIs, refactor send_file and SharedDataMiddleware, plus docs, changelog and tests.

intents.text: Add Response.apply_conditions(request, *, exists=True) in wrappers/response.py evaluating If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since in RFC 9110 order for all methods, with star ETag depending on `exists`, raising PreconditionFailed on failure, producing 304 (entity headers removed) for satisfied If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since on GET/HEAD, and setting Accept-Ranges: bytes.

Add Response.apply_range(request) applying only the bytes Range after conditions (honouring If-Range via IfRange.check), clamping too-large stop/suffix, using only the first range, raising RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable when unsatisfiable, else a 206 with sliced data and Content-Range.
Keep Response.make_conditional working but emit DeprecationWarning, implemented via apply_conditions and apply_range.
Deprecate werkzeug.http.is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid with DeprecationWarning.

Make Range.from_header, Range.make_content_range and ContentRange.from_header validate their own values; make_content_range clamps too-large stop/suffix and uses the first range when several are given.
Add IfRange.check(etag, last_modified) -> bool in datastructures/range.py, true for a strong ETag equal to etag or a date equal to last_modified.
Make ETagSet.from_header discard invalid unquoted values.

Refactor send_file in utils.py to use the new methods: detect name/size/mtime from file-like objects when possible, seek(0) file-likes, drop the path hash from the ETag, and default mimetype to application/octet-stream when download_name is absent instead of raising.
Make SharedDataMiddleware serve files through send_file, stop setting cache_timeout by default, and deprecate (still accept, with DeprecationWarning) the cache and fallback_mimetype parameters.
Document the new methods in the quickstart docs and add a changelog entry.

Add tests for apply_conditions (each header, methods, star ETag with/without resource, 304 vs 412) and apply_range (first range only, clamping, unsatisfiable, 206 Content-Range); update send_file tests for new behaviour; move/remove tests of deprecated functions; suite `pytest -m "not dev_server"` stays green.

constraints: Everything not listed in the request stays unchanged
Only the bytes range unit is supported
Deprecated APIs must still work and emit DeprecationWarning
Test suite must pass with pytest -m "not dev_server"
